sloka: तम् आनय महाभागम् स्वयम् एव सुसत्कृतम् ।पूर्व संबन्धिनम् ज्ञात्वा ततः पूर्वम् ब्रवीमि ते ॥१-१३-२२॥
transliteration: tam ānaya mahābhāgam svayam eva susatkṛtam ।pūrva saṁbandhinam jñātvā tataḥ pūrvam bravīmi te ॥1-13-22॥

translations.english: Similarly, you may personally escort king of Kasi who is always affectionate and sweettongued. He is a friend to our king who is a lion among rulers.
